name: cate.datasette
description: Datasette wrapper, a server-backed Cate extension. Launches a local Datasette over the workspace's SQLite files and embeds its UI, reverse-proxied and loopback-bound.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && npm run build:panel && node ./copy-static.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
